title: This Month vs. Last Month vs. Last Year
description: This report is for comparing a month's travel time, average hours of delay, and speed to the previous month and the same month the year prior. The report is intended to give the analyst a month vs month, and month by year over year look at changes.
_note: Reconstructed via --from-page 2210548. Dates/names applied directly from scratchpad/npmrds-sub/apply_today_relative_patches.py's own REPORTS dict (the intended patch that silently failed to persist, per report-spec-and-build-script.md's root-cause finding) rather than re-derived by hand. 15 of the original 22 sections (1 Map, 2 Bar Graph Summaries, 12 individual 'Day of Week' bar graphs) referenced ONLY orphaned comp ids (dedicated day-of-week sub-routes for each period, made obsolete once day-of-week filtering moved from route-level to graph-level — zero overlap with the current 4 routes, confirmed by reading live routeIds directly) and were already fully non-functional on the live page. Per Ryan's direct question: rather than just dropping that capability, rebuilt the 'day of week' and 'one bar per period' comparisons using the SAME 4 real routes (weekday_delay/weekday_traveltime/weekday_speed, bar_summary_traveltime, map_traveltime below) — no dead routes needed, since that filtering is graph-level now. One exception: the original also had a 'Bar Graph Summary, Avg. Hours of Delay' — needs the avgHoursOfDelay+summary combo, still guarded/unbuilt (this is now the SECOND real template needing it, after Single Route — worth building for real once the full sweep is done, not hypothetical anymore). That one panel stays dropped.
